content:
maria: :rotating_light: incident-bot auto-detected unusual KV cache growth and continuous-batching spike on prod-cluster-12. alert: memory pressure rising, allocator fragmentation climb. markers: gpu12-memory 96% -> 99% in 12m. starting thread for triage.
incident-bot: Pager triggered (sev2). Runbook: kv-cache-frag -> https://internal/runbooks/kv-cache-frag. Pager: @ashwin, @eli.
ashwin: I'm oncall, I see the alert. pulling metrics now. p99 gen latency for /v1/rerank up from 120ms -> 520ms. 5xx rate ~2.0% on the scoring path.
eli: grabbing allocator telemetry. `nvml` shows fragmentation pattern, many small cuda allocations returned to arena but not coalesced. suspect recent batch-config change rolled 03:04 UTC.
maria: deploy history shows commit `deploy/2026-03-14/03:04:21` updated continuous-batching heuristics (auto-burst enabled).
ashwin: ok attempting quick rollback of batching heuristics to previous safe profile. applying change: `rdwctl rollout set-config cluster=prod-cluster-12 key=continuous_batching.profile value=safe-2026-03-01`
ashwin: command output:
```
$ rdwctl rollout set-config cluster=prod-cluster-12 key=continuous_batching.profile value=safe-2026-03-01
status: accepted, rollout_id=rr-5621
started: 03:22:41 UTC
```
maria: starting live compaction on nodes with highest fragmentation. running compaction script on gpu12 and gpu14.
eli: compaction logs (excerpt):
```
[03:24:10] compaction: node=gpu12 freed_pages=18432 freed_bytes=73MB
[03:24:25] compaction: node=gpu14 freed_pages=12288 freed_bytes=48MB
```
jordan: joining the bridge. brief: allocator tuning + revert batching. handing to eng-runtime for deeper allocator fix.
ashwin: rolling temporary route fallback for high-latency requests: set policy to prefer smaller model variant for reranking for 5% of traffic and throttle large requests.
maria: applying traffic steering:
```
$ rdwctl route update service=rerank policy=telemetry:latency fallback_model=open-rank-1.1-small percent=5
ok
```
eli: running `pytorch-malloc` diagnostics. found repeated `cudaMalloc` churn where freed blocks were not returning to OS due to arena fragmentation. heuristics show many allocations in 1-8KB range causing slab blowout.
ashwin: temp mitigations in place: rollback batch config, compaction, route fallback, enable per-route throttles. observing metrics.
maria: customer-impact snapshot: Affected endpoints: reranker and search-scorer. Impact window ~03:05-03:30 UTC. SLO hits: error budget consumed higher for some tenants (not global outage). Notified SRE & Support to prepare customer comms.
incident-bot: Note: automated canary rollback health checks report partial recovery after config revert. Continue monitoring for 30m before declaring stable.
jordan: planning next step: runtime patch to adjust arena free threshold and defragmentation aggressiveness. propose param changes: `arena.free_threshold=0.25`, `slab.reclaim_min_age=30s`, `contbatch.max_inflight=6`. anyone object?
eli: agree. will prepare hotpatch and smoke test on staging. patch will include small allocator fix to reduce fragmentation for small allocations and a safety circuit to drop extreme batch expansion.
maria: while patch is being prepared, I'm increasing eviction aggressiveness on affected nodes: `kvctl evict --cluster prod-cluster-12 --policy aggressive --target 12,14` to free hot prefixes.
ashwin: live metrics after rollback+compaction (03:29 UTC): p99 latency down to ~180ms, 5xx down to 0.6%. memory pressure dropping on gpu12 -> 82%. still watching tail.
eli: hotpatch ready. test plan: deploy to canary pool (gpu18), run load generator that reproduces continuous-batching profile, assert no fragmentation increase after 20m.
jordan: canary pass initiated. smoke results in chat: success, fragmentation stable, p99 okay. scheduling rolling hotpatch to remainder of cluster with 1-node-at-a-time cadence.
maria: executing rolling hotpatch. command log:
```
$ rdwctl deploy-hotpatch name=allocator-frag-fix-2026-03-14 target=prod-cluster-12 cadence=1
rolling: node=gpu18 -> patched
rolling: node=gpu12 -> patched
```
ashwin: post-patch metrics (03:43 UTC): fragmentation curves flattened, memory pressure normalizing, p99 ~130ms, 5xx ~0.2%. Good.
maria: customer-impact update: initial affected customers saw increased latencies and a small fraction of requests retried. no data loss, no degraded model outputs. Support to send summary to affected tenants with mitigation steps.
eli: taking notes for postmortem. suspected root cause summary: change to continuous-batching heuristics increased small allocation churn -> allocator fragmentation under PyTorch CUDA allocator -> failure to coalesce -> memory blowup. fix: revert heuristics, allocator param changes, more conservative batching defaults + telemetry to detect small-allocation bursts.
ashwin: owners for follow-up: eng-runtime (eli), oncall (ashwin), product regarding default batching (maria). postmortem doc scheduled and will be created in #postmortems within 24h.
incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. please update the incident runbook with the hotpatch commands you used.
jordan: will open a PR with improved integration tests for cont-batching+allocator patterns. tagging eng-ml for review of model batching behavior.
maria: final note: thanks all for quick responses. recommend adding a guard to rollout that blocks `auto-burst` toggles without a canary that measures small-allocation rate.
ashwin: handing back to normal rotation. closing this bridge in 15m if stable. :white_check_mark:
